title: Issue Interface Contract
description: Standard interface for code review issues generated by code-reviewer and processed by confidence-scorer

file.description: Relative file path from project root

line.description: Line number where the issue occurs

column.description: Optional column number for precise location

severity.description:
Issue severity level:
- info: Informational, no action required
- warning: Should be fixed but not blocking
- error: Should be fixed before merge
- critical: Must be fixed immediately, security/data risk

category.description: Issue category for classification and filtering

examples: Potential SQL injection in user query
Missing error handling in async function

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue, why it matters, and potential impact

confidence.description:
Confidence score (0-100):
- 95-100: Critical issues, definitely needs fixing
- 80-94: High confidence, likely a real issue
- 60-79: Medium confidence, requires human review
- 0-59: Low confidence, may be false positive

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this confidence score was assigned

references.description: Links to documentation, OWASP, CWE, or related resources

related_issues.description: IDs of related issues in this review

auto_fixable.description: Whether this issue can be automatically fixed

false_positive_likelihood.description: Estimated likelihood this is a false positive

examples.title: SQL injection vulnerability in user search
examples.description: User input is directly concatenated into SQL query without sanitization. An attacker could inject malicious SQL to access or modify unauthorized data.
examples.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or ORM methods instead of string concatenation
examples.code_snippet: const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '${userInput}'`
examples.suggested_fix: const query = sql`SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ${userInput}`
examples.reasoning: Direct string concatenation of user input into SQL query is a textbook SQL injection pattern

examples.title: Unhandled promise rejection in file upload
examples.description: Async function lacks try-catch block. If uploadFile() rejects, it will cause an unhandled rejection.
examples.suggestion: Wrap async operations in try-catch and return proper error response
examples.reasoning: Missing error handling in async route handler is a common source of crashes
